reason: All 6 linux_riscv64 CI jobs fail with a dependency solver error: `cross-python_linux-riscv64` has no candidates. This is an ecosystem-level missing dependency (the riscv64 cross-Python toolchain package is not yet available in conda-forge), not a feedstock code or recipe bug. All other platforms (linux_64, linux_aarch64, linux_ppc64le, osx_64, osx_arm64, win_64) pass cleanly.
